newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 111.9 in July.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 111.9 in July.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) monthly future inflation gauge (FIG) rose to 111.9 in July from a revised 111.3 in June, ECRI said.

Faster growth in civilian employment, less negative growth in industrial materials prices and a sharp narrowing of the yield spread between 10-year notes and three-month Treasury bills, pushed the gauge higher, ECRI said.

"Because the rise in the FIG has been checked primarily by decreases in the prices of imports and industrial materials, the upturn in underlying inflationary pressures will become a greater concern if those prices start showing significant increases," ECRI said.
